record.question: Under the Biomedical waste management rules 2015, how should expired medicines be disposed, if it's not possible to return to the manufacturer?
options: Remove the packaging, crush the drugs and mix with general waste
To inform the local municipal authorities
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Incineration at >1200 °Celsius. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q66. The examiner selects option C. The source’s 2015 rules citation is retained; this is not an independently updated disposal protocol for all pharmaceutical waste.
